## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] No private data (audio, real transcripts, names, tokens); `npm run check:privacy` is clean
- [ ] Docs updated (Spanish docs are `*.es.md`; UI strings go through the dictionaries)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) and follow Conventional Commits
